source_caption_text:
This was the beginning of a whole new Don Toliver era 💆🏽‍♂️🔥

When “No Idea” first came on, it felt like Don Toliver had suddenly arrived. After getting attention from his appearances around Travis Scott’s *Astroworld* era, the Houston artist stepped forward with a sound that was completely his own. The opening seconds of “No Idea” still bring you straight back to that moment.

The song had everything that made Don stand out: the hazy production, his instantly recognizable voice, and that effortless way he floated over the beat. It didn’t sound like he was trying to fit into the wave around him. He already sounded like someone building his own lane.

Then “No Idea” took off online and introduced that sound to a much bigger audience. Looking back now, it’s one of those songs where you can hear the exact moment a rising artist stopped feeling like a hidden gem and started sounding like a star.

#dontoliver #rap #hiphop
